subject: EVALUATE directive
notes: kb/Work PB1364. cite.py --check 7.3.13.3 'Arithmetic-expression-1, arithmetic-expression-2, and arithmetic-expression-3 shall be formed in accordance with 7.3.6, Compile-time arithmetic expressions.' OK 14). MatchWhen parses and formation-checks the operand of EVERY >>WHEN of a compiled EVALUATE (`>>WHEN 2 ** 3` after a matching WHEN is COBOL1619, SR1a of 7.3.6.2), and an EVALUATE in an omitted branch has its operands fragment-parsed (CheckOperandSyntax, ISO 7.2.1) though never evaluated.
